preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'timescaledb'

changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS wattwerk
CREATE TABLE wattwerk.aggregated ( bucket_time timestamptz NOT NULL, series text NOT NULL, value double precision NOT NULL, unit text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (bucket_time, series) )
SELECT create_hypertable( 'wattwerk.aggregated', 'bucket_time', chunk_time_interval => INTERVAL '7 days', if_not_exists => TRUE )
CREATE TABLE wattwerk.history ( bucket_time timestamptz NOT NULL, series text NOT NULL, value double precision NOT NULL, unit text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (bucket_time, series) )
SELECT create_hypertable( 'wattwerk.history', 'bucket_time', chunk_time_interval => INTERVAL '30 days', if_not_exists => TRUE )

changeSet.author: wattwerk
changeSet.sql: SELECT add_retention_policy( 'wattwerk.aggregated', drop_after => INTERVAL '5 years', if_not_exists => TRUE )

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'openhab'

changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW openhab.items AS SELECT time, item_id, value, string, unit, downsampled FROM public.items
CREATE VIEW openhab.item_meta AS SELECT id, name, label, value, metadata, created_at FROM public.item_meta
CREATE FUNCTION openhab.reject_raw_data_write() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'openHAB data is read-only to WattWerk'; END; $$
CREATE TRIGGER items_read_only INSTEAD OF INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON openhab.items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION openhab.reject_raw_data_write()
CREATE TRIGGER item_meta_read_only INSTEAD OF INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON openhab.item_meta FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION openhab.reject_raw_data_write()
